attempts.summary: Set up centralized log forwarding: node2 runs an 'inventory' systemd service logging via syslog tag 'inventory'; rsyslog on node2 forwards those messages over TCP/514 (with a disk-assisted, infinite-retry queue) to node1, where rsyslog (imtcp) writes them to /var/log/inventory/node2.log. Firewalld on node1 permanently allows 514/tcp. Both rsyslog and inventory.service are enabled at boot. Verified end-to-end delivery before and after independently restarting node1 and node2 (native systemctl reboot, one at a time), confirming changed boot_id and full recovery of forwarding on each.
